name: Qube Browser 0.4.0 (v2)
notes:
Qube v2 is here. A brand-new engine, Apple Music built in, and a lot more to love. This is the biggest Qube update yet.

A whole new engine:
* Pages load fast and work the way they should
* Your sign-ins, site data and permissions come along by themselves
* Streaming video and music just work
* Qube starts noticeably faster

Your music, built in:
* Apple Music lives inside Qube: your library, search and playlists, right in the Library
* A player in the sidebar, next to everything else that plays
* Now Playing with lyrics in the side panel
* Your music picks up where you left off, even after a restart

Watch and listen:
* Picture in picture, by hand or the moment you leave a playing video
* Spotify, Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video, HBO Max, Videoland and NPO, each in a tab of its own
* Media players in the sidebar, with a volume slider for each
* Music notes dance over any tab that plays sound; click its icon to mute it

Built around your Spaces:
* Profiles: give a Space its own, or let Spaces share one
* Create Spaces right in the sidebar and drag them into your own order
* Air Traffic Control: links from other apps land in the Space you choose
* Your own icon on tabs, Essentials, folders and Spaces: an icon, an emoji or a picture
* Tab groups that save as folders, and pinned tabs that fold away with one click

Work the way you want:
* More than one window, and private windows
* A side panel for extensions, Apple Music, or any tab you want next to your page
* Drag and drop: drop files, text and links onto a page, or drag from a page into another app
* Search any site straight from the command bar: type its name and press Tab
* Import from Arc or Zen, alongside what you have or instead of it
* Qube Spark: hold Shift over a link for a preview, and let Tidy sort your tabs

Made to feel good:
* The first start after your PC boots, Qube unpacks itself from its own box
* The window fades in once your page is ready
* Folders, rows and buttons move and fade as you use them
* Richer Space colours throughout

And more:
* Your history as a page of its own, and archived tabs in the Library
* Downloads fly to the Library button
* Save as PDF and Print
* Notifications from your sites
* A redesigned Settings
* Background tabs rest to save battery and memory
* A setup guide that gets you going on first start

Fixed:
* Links from other apps now reach a Qube that is already open
* Downloads from every Space show up, and never overwrite a file with the same name
* Clear Cookies clears the Space you are in
* Deleting a Space no longer signs you out
* Imports keep your Essentials and theme colours right

Good to know:
* Extensions don't come along on their own: Qube lists yours with a link to add them again, and their saved data comes back when you do
* Qube isn't signed yet, so Windows' Smart App Control blocks it. Turn it off in Windows Security > App & browser control
* The update is about 420 MB, and Qube steps away for a minute or two while it installs
summary: Qube v2 is here: a brand-new engine, Apple Music built in, and a lot more to love.

mac.name: Qube for Mac 0.3.2
mac.notes:
Added:

* Create a Space in the sidebar: name, icon, profile and theme, before it is made
* Collapse your pinned tabs: click the Space's name
* Hold the mouse button on the Space buttons and sweep across them to go through your Spaces
* The Library has icons of its own that move when you choose a section, in your Space's colour
* The Library button is a toy box: point at it and its stars come up

Changed:

* The sidebar follows Zen's sizes, spacing, corners and colours, without glass on glass
* Switching Spaces slides the old one out as the new one comes in, over half a second
* Clear and Tidy stay under your pinned tabs instead of scrolling away
* The URL bar stays put when you switch Spaces
* A new Space's empty Essentials area is no taller than a row of Essentials

Fixed:

* Importing from Zen put every Essential in every Space
* Importing from Arc gave some Spaces the wrong colours
* The Library's section buttons stretched to the window's height
* On a click, the new Space showed over the old one for a moment before it slid in

Known:

* To fix an earlier import, import again and choose Replace
mac.summary: A sidebar that looks and moves more like Zen's, and a Library of Qube's own.
